svg.title: The same task. A very different regression.

cc:Work.dc:title: The same task. A very different regression.
cc:Work.dc:description: Unbounded mean WER on ALLSTAR HINT 2. Nkore English: 7.0% to 71.7% (+64.7 percentage points); MUSE: 1.3% to 6.6% (+5.3 points). This compares releases from different developers, not a vendor update. Source: saved scores and the paper’s roughly 65-point regression example.
